decision_rule: PRE-REGISTERED DECISION RULE: a feature group IMPROVES the field model only if, on E2 qc_regions_loco (leave one Quebec cell out), its change in balanced accuracy versus base is > 0 AND the 90% paired cluster-bootstrap interval (resampling cells) excludes 0. E1 and E3 are supporting evidence only. Maryland (n=44, one farm) is underpowered and never used for selection.

settings.model: kernelag.field_model.make_model (median imputer, scaler, balanced logistic C=0.5)

group:dairy_balance.quebec_maize_2023: county dairy balance needs dairy cows and corn area by region; the repository has none for Quebec (would need Statistics Canada Census of Agriculture 2021 by census division plus the division boundaries); see README
group:dairy_balance.qc_regions_2023: county dairy balance needs dairy cows and corn area by region; the repository has none for Quebec (would need Statistics Canada Census of Agriculture 2021 by census division plus the division boundaries); see README
group:dairy_balance.barc_2021_2023: all 34 fields lie in one county (Prince George's, MD, FIPS 24033): the county prior is a single value per year for every field, so it carries no field-level information (county_prior.csv has it for 2023 only; milk cows are withheld for 2021-2022)

groups.description: County dairy feed-demand balance (DOCS/research/dairy_prior.md 8.2). Tested at county and state level in run.py; not a field feature for any labelled dataset.

uncomputed.barc_2021_2023: roll-based columns UNCOMPUTED (NaN): no public registry of dairy sites comparable to the Quebec assessment roll covers Maryland; Climate TRACE lists 39 Maryland dairies from state permit lists, not the research farm's own herd. Climate TRACE columns are built.

groups.description: Distance from each maize field to dairy sites of the Quebec property assessment roll (MAMH role d'evaluation fonciere 2023, CC BY 4.0): units with CUBF 8122 'Elevage de bovins laitiers' (legacy 8150), a building value above zero and an accepted point. dairydist_d_dairy_km = km from the field's representative point to the nearest dairy site; dairydist_n_dairy_18km = dairy sites within 18 km; rule = 1 when the nearest dairy site is within 1.5 km. Distances in EPSG:32618. Herd size is UNCOMPUTED (the roll has none). Maryland has no comparable registry: roll-based columns are NaN there. Climate TRACE columns (descriptive) cover every dataset.

Optical harvest dates (kernelag.features peak_doy, cut_doy) expressed in thermal time: corn modified GDD in degC-days (base 10, cap 30, both temperatures clipped to 10-30), cumulative from May 1, from Open-Meteo archive daily Tmax/Tmin (ERA5-Land, ERA5 fallback) at each 10 km cell centre. gdd_peak_to_cut = GDD(cut) - GDD(peak); gdd_share_at_cut = GDD(cut) / GDD(May 1-Oct 31). Descriptive only: gdd_at_cut, gdd_season_may_oct. No benchmark rule: the research thresholds are relative to black layer, which no input here observes.

Published September moisture rule, Lin et al. 2025 (Agronomy 15(6):1438, TempDiff-SMID, Hohhot): silage if September LSWI <= 0.15, else grain. LSWI = repo ndmi (B8A, B11). Literal port fixed before evaluation: rule = median of clear (valid_frac >= 0.5) Sentinel-2 looks dated 1-30 September <= 0.15; NaN when the field-year has no clear September look. Features: that median and the September minimum. Calendar-bound by design: the paper's thresholds were re-tuned by hand each year and one harvest calendar does not transfer across regions.
